evaluation_basis: Assessed against two frozen hypotheses with holdout-safe thresholds and paired moving-block inference; risk improvement cannot substitute for statistical alpha evidence.
original_objective: Test cost-aware abstention as an alpha-conversion mechanism and externally replicate the v0.11 HIGH_VOL/TREND_DOWN Ichimoku condition on OKX.

engineering_result.summary: Both frozen experiments, cost accounting, point-in-time regimes, paired bootstrap and hashed result artifact completed successfully.

scientific_result.summary: Decisions were NO_COST_AWARE_CONVERSION_EVIDENCE and NO_EXTERNAL_REGIME_REPLICATION_EVIDENCE because both confidence intervals crossed zero.

economic_result.summary: Cost-aware: -7.48% to +0.048%, MDD -13.57% to -1.32%, turnover 114 to 10. External conditioned Ichimoku: -9.07% to -2.79%, MDD -30.96% to -17.99%; still negative and statistically inconclusive.

contribution_to_next_version: Retained cost-aware abstention as a risk-control hypothesis and required new strategy families/evidence rather than promoting attractive risk reductions.
